results.title: Global string filters
results.notes: Global string predicates normalize to a single-expression AND group; object filters remain supported.

results.title: Per-view filters key
results.notes: Obsidian views[].filters imports into the native singular filter model; native filter wins when both keys exist, and writes retain the Lapis format.

results.title: Global AND view filters
results.notes: Global and per-view predicates compose with AND for imported and native documents.

results.title: Recursive and/or/not groups
results.notes: Full loader-to-query acceptance; not excludes any matching child.

results.title: Comparison operators
results.notes: Standard comparisons, including double-equals, execute through the same lowering boundary as formulas; native single-equals remains accepted.

results.title: Symbolic boolean operators and truthiness
results.notes: Symbolic logic and numeric truthiness are compiled to boolean predicates before evaluation.

results.title: Bare, note-dot and bracket properties
results.notes: Bracketed note keys use typed literal-key lookups, preserving whitespace, dots and reserved names.

results.title: Arithmetic and precedence
results.notes: Arithmetic precedence, grouping, unary minus, division and modulo.

results.title: Formula references in filters
results.notes: Dotted and bracketed formula references resolve through the same execution compiler without rewriting string literals.

results.title: Formula chains and formula sorting
results.notes: Formula chains preserve arithmetic precedence and both formula-ID spellings sort by evaluated values.

results.title: this binding
results.notes: A query has no owning-note binding in BasesTable or QueryController; real embed ownership needs a host fixture.

results.title: Date fields and arithmetic
results.notes: Luxon values must implement the documented Bases date and duration semantics.

results.title: File fields
results.notes: Tests runtime metadata, not display wrappers; tags include nested frontmatter tags.

results.title: Frontmatter links resolve as typed links
results.notes: Documented wikilinks support asFile and file comparisons; current metadata keeps raw strings.

results.notes: Registrations and governed stories exist. Layout names do not establish compatibility with every Obsidian view setting.

results.title: Interactive map
results.notes: Map renders an explicit unavailable surface; interactive map/provider support remains absent.

review.acceptance: Provide a real map provider and test geospatial data, navigation and disposal.

results.title: Sort, group, manual groups and collapse
results.notes: Basic sorting and grouping exist; manual group ordering, hidden groups and explicit empty groups need separate acceptance.

review.acceptance: Load Obsidian manual group configuration, hide/reorder/add empty groups, and verify persistence.

results.title: Default and custom summaries
results.notes: Built-in summary branches exist, but grouped and arbitrary custom formula semantics are not fully qualified.

review.acceptance: Check every default summary plus values.mean().round(3) globally and per group.

results.title: Embeds and named-view fragments
results.notes: Read-only file and fenced embeds exist; Obsidian ![[File.base#View]] selection requires focused host acceptance.

review.acceptance: Verify fragment-selected views, this ownership and independent repeated embed lifecycles.

results.title: Search, edit, create, export and clipboard
results.notes: Lapis has governed workflow and editable-cell stories; copying formatted results and complete Obsidian workflow parity are unverified.

review.acceptance: Exercise search over displayed properties, CRUD, CSV and clipboard with the same fixtures in both hosts.

results.title: Circular references and diagnostics
results.notes: The execution compiler rejects circular and unknown formula references; the UI retains its editing toolbar and shows a bounded error. Source and governed story regressions cover this behavior.
